claycode.delta: CC-WP-03/04/06/11 should define and test typed canonical numeric leaves, target-range exactness and special-float policy before numeric values enter semantic_hash or cross-runtime differential replay. No new syntax requested.

harness.delta: Add numeric identity goldens to semantic/source/runtime/trace separation: +0/-0, representative exponent-format values, NaN/Infinity policy, 2^53 boundary, int64 edges and exact replay hashes.

unifieddb.delta: Do not derive semantic identity from SQLite REAL presentation or host JSON formatting. Where numeric values participate in authoritative semantic hashes/receipts, retain type plus canonical semantic value and keep presentation/derived indexes separate.

claygraph.delta: REAL weight/confidence values are derived topology/readout data. If included in projection/selection hashes, use typed canonical numeric identity; this does not promote activation or weight to truth/authority.

frank.delta: LoopDynamicsReadout and other numeric state need deterministic typed identity for replay, but this is Research-Entity representation infrastructure, not a Frank self-harness change and not evidence for the loop-of-loops mechanism itself.

gwt.delta: Numeric selection/readout axes should have explicit finite/special/unknown semantics; accidental NaN/null coercion must not become an epistemic or authority signal.

hyperposition.delta: Coupling/gain/phase numerics need reproducible typed identity across epochs/backends while preserving ordered/set-valued topology distinctions.

emergenz.delta: Deterministic numeric representation improves measurement/replay hygiene only. It is not emergence evidence and does not validate PID/PEID or causal claims by itself.

clayresearch.delta: Treat numeric semantic identity as a cross-cutting compiler/runtime invariant supporting replay and safe-effect evidence. It does not change the fixed semantic authority boundary or justify a new architecture primitive.
